judge_reasoning: Prompt anchor: “What is ai”. Candidate [1] gives a broadly correct, general definition of AI with reasonable classifications (narrow/general) and common subfields (machine learning/deep learning) without major factual distortions. Candidate [3] is mostly accurate but includes a key verified-false historical claim that AI’s term was coined by Marvin Minsky in 1956 (it’s associated with John McCarthy at the 1956 Dartmouth workshop). Candidate [2] and especially [4] contain multiple implausible or clearly false specifics (e.g., early-19th-century conceptualization, Babbage “functional AI,” robots doing most surgeries, autonomous flying cars), making them far less reliable.
